concours.name: La tente du Concours
concours.alt: The judging tent of the village show under a green-and-cream striped big top, painted in ink and gouache: a four-tier round wooden stand around the central pole. Two sheep in matching hats and rosettes stand on top beside a bee wearing a rosette; a crow balances on melons, mice watch a monster film on a little screen, and a goose wears a big rosette. A judge recoils from a sunken crater cake, a girl hugs a huge pear, a judge pins a rosette on a giant cabbage, another holds up ten fingers by an ice-cream parfait, a judge and a goblin gasp at a green cake, a grandma gives a thumbs-up by a pink cake, and a pumpkin grins beside a golden trophy. On the rug a grandad pours lemonade and twin drummers march. A plank door with a jam jar on the left, doors with a carrot and a cake on the right, and four coloured doors on a balcony reached by a ladder lead to the other rooms; the open tent flap at the far left leads out to the park.

confitures.name: Les confitures
confitures.alt: The jam corner of the judging tent, painted in ink and gouache, with shelves of jam jars on the right and a round three-tier stand in the middle: an ant carries a medal, an owl judge holds a jam jar, a cat naps beside a blue rosette, and a peacock sits in a toy van by a framed portrait. A normal tomato sits by a giant one, a hedgehog studies a diamond through a magnifier, a rabbit judge holds up a ticket beside a pony, and a mouse chef shows a two-tier cake. A toy pier sinks in a washtub, a mouse drips under a holey teal umbrella, a badger checks a stingray in a tank, a fox girl holds a teal pocket knife, and a puppy sits by a chewed slipper. On the rug a mouse judge drops a wilted lettuce in a crate and two pigs share a marrow. The plank door with the jam jar on the left leads back to the main tent.

potager.name: Le potager
potager.alt: The vegetable corner of the judging tent, painted in ink and gouache, with crates of carrots, cabbages and potatoes on the right and a round stand in the middle: an owl gives a thumbs-up, a mouse stands by a tall trophy and a little pumpkin, a dean in cap and gown holds a rosette, two mice share an apple, a cake has a single seed on top, and a beaver sorts papers. Judges with a magnifier inspect a giant marrow, a carrot shaped like a rabbit offends a real rabbit, a knight rides a gnu past waving onlookers, and a grandma pins a rosette on a boy with a stack of pies. The door with the carrot on the left leads back to the main tent.

gateaux.name: Les gâteaux
gateaux.alt: The cake corner of the judging tent, painted in ink and gouache, with a baker's rack of tins and flour sacks on the right and a round stand in the middle: a girl waters a sunflower that grows through the roof, a giraffe peeps in, a gull sings opera to cheering judges, and a pony judge frowns at cupcakes. A goat wears the judge's rosette as the judge gasps, a judge peers through a huge magnifier, and an elephant admires a cake full of candles. A little table sags under a pumpkin, a judge winces at his soup as a dog backs away, and on the rug a boy holds up five fingers from under a pile of cake tins. The plank door on the left leads back to the main tent.

jury.name: La loge du jury
jury.alt: The judges' room of the tent, painted in ink and gouache, with a board of rosettes and a hat stand on the right and a round stand in the middle: a mockingbird copies a tiny judge, a dozing judge dreams of a beach, a judge cracks a crème brûlée, a whale stares at a tiny slice of cake, and a hedgehog shrugs at a lumpy green dish. A duck sits in a washtub, a piglet grins by a mud cake, a judge holds up a mouldy pie with flies, and a waistcoat hangs by loose threads. On the rug judges walk round a giant marrow statue and a snail follows a blank signpost. The blue door on the left leads back to the main tent.

doors.label: La tente du Concours
doors.hint: Go back through the blue door to the main tent

rates.name: Les ratés
rates.alt: The mishaps loft of the tent, painted in ink and gouache, with shelves of bowls and sieves on the right and a four-tier stand in the middle: a crowned pumpkin loses its cape in the breeze, a judge climbs a ladder to pin a huge marrow, and a marrow dragon wears a ribbon. A cake slides sideways as the chef topper leaps, a soufflé collapses, and a fly holds its nose over stinky green soup. A judge sneezes a dandelion clock away, a tin of beans bursts over a judge, and a jack-in-the-box springs out as a kitten leaps back. A lady shakes a pebble out of her shoe, a judge mouse counts a ladybird's seven spots, and an octopus in a football shirt waves its eighth arm. The yellow door on the left leads back to the main tent.

doors.hint: Go back through the yellow door to the main tent

espoirs.name: Les espoirs
espoirs.alt: The rising-stars loft of the tent, painted in ink and gouache, with shelves of seedlings and watering cans on the right and a four-tier stand in the middle: a tortoise plods past an open storybook, a seedling sprouts in a pot, and a judge stands beside his carrot-headed lookalike. A judge tastes jam, two children crowd a table of cakes, and a prawn is gripped by a storybook. An old tortoise judge holds a spoon, snails crawl along their own flagged lane, and a mouse asks a question by a cheese. A teddy naps among mended toys and a robot peels a mountain of potatoes. The red door on the left leads back to the main tent.

sante.name: La santé
sante.alt: The health-and-safety loft of the tent, painted in ink and gouache, with shelves of first-aid tins, bandages and gloves on the right and a four-tier stand in the middle: a grass snake naps under a straw hat, a little van parks by a tent door, and a horse shakes his head at a greasy burger. A little cloud rains on prize roses, a worn-out shoe flaps open, and a dog trots back from a walk. A goat leaps off a little table, fumes from a burnt pie make a judge cough, and a hedgehog holds an umbrella under a sunny sky. An old flowered yo-yo lies by a pocket watch, a lion sulks in bunny ears, and a dog hides under a flowered cushion with sausages peeking out. The green door on the left leads back to the main tent.

potager_casier.name: La vitrine des prix
potager_casier.alt: A close-up of the little wooden prize cabinet in the vegetable corner, painted in ink and gouache, with a carved pumpkin on top and six cubbies: a judge takes one bite of pie and rings a hand bell; a green parrot bows to a prize marrow; a kind bearded judge pats the shoulder of a nervous girl holding a jam jar; a shopkeeper hands a girl a parcel and a little blank paper slip; a tall tiered white cake with two sugar swans; a red-faced judge gulps a tall glass of water by a plate of chillies. Crates of carrots, leeks and cabbages stand on either side.

gateaux_casier.name: Le buffet des gâteaux
gateaux_casier.alt: A close-up of the little wooden cupboard in the cake corner, painted in ink and gouache, with a pink iced cake on top and six cubbies: a sad girl in a party hat holds a popped balloon; a hen in a bow tie pecks politely at a pie; two sweating judges fan themselves with fern leaves; a wobbly tower of marmalade jars on a little table as a mouse tiptoes past; a ginger cat lifts a checked cloth to peek at a blob of cream; a delivery van tips honey pots over a cake table while the baker clutches his head. Stacks of cake tins and flour sacks stand on either side.
